declarations.name: IdentityDocumentProviderRegistrationStore
declarations.comment:
A store that is used to notify the system which documents an app has available for presentment.

The information registered with this store will be used to appropriately surface your app as an option during a presentment.
When a particular document is registered, it is expected that the authorization UI provided through the app's `IdentityDocumentProvider` extension will be able to handle incoming requests for that particular document.
The app should only register documents that are active and able to be successfully presented. If a document becomes inactive, it should be unregistered from the store.

members.name: addRegistration
members.signature: func addRegistration(_ registration: some IdentityDocumentRegistration) async throws
members.comment:
Register a document with the system.

If the provided registration contains a `documentIdentifier` that has already been registered, the existing registration will be replaced by the provided registration.
- Parameter registration: A registration that contains information about the document necessary to surface it appropriately during a presentment.

members.name: removeRegistration
members.signature: func removeRegistration(forDocumentIdentifier documentIdentifier: String) async throws
members.comment:
Unregister a particular document with the system.

When a document is unregistered, your app will no longer be surfaced as an option for responding to a presentment request for that particular document.
- Parameter documentIdentifier: The identifier of the document to unregister.

members.name: unownedExecutor
members.signature: nonisolated final var unownedExecutor: UnownedSerialExecutor { get }
members.comment:
Retrieve the executor for this actor as an optimized, unowned
reference.

This property must always evaluate to the same executor for a
given actor instance, and holding on to the actor must keep the
executor alive.

This property will be implicitly accessed when work needs to be
scheduled onto this actor.  These accesses may be merged,
eliminated, and rearranged with other work, and they may even
be introduced when not strictly required.  Visible side effects
are therefore strongly discouraged within this property.

- SeeAlso: ``SerialExecutor``
- SeeAlso: ``TaskExecutor``

declarations.name: MobileDocumentRegistration
declarations.comment:
A type used for registering mobile documents.

Mobile documents, or "mdocs", are a document format defined in ISO 18013-5.

members.comment:
Initialize a mobile document registration with issuer key identifiers.
- Parameters:
  - mobileDocumentType: The type of the mobile document.
  - supportedIssuerKeyIdentifiers: A list of X.509 authority key identifiers that correspond to the document signer certificate chain for the mobile document.
  - supportedAuthorityKeyIdentifiers: A list of authority key identifiers that correspond to relying party authorizers that are trusted by the document provider app.
  - documentIdentifier: An identifier that uniquely refers to the document that is registered. If not provided, a random unique identifier will be chosen.
